newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bovespa sees 208.9 mln-real inflow in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Bovespa sees 208.9 mln-real inflow in Feb.

text.p: The Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) said it registered net foreign capital inflows of 208.9 million reais in the first seven days of February.
Foreign buys amounted to 932.6 million reais in the period versus foreign sells of 723.7 million reais, it said.
In January, the Bovespa saw net capital inflows of 681.7 million reais, it said.
So far this year, net foreign capital inflows have totalled 890.7 million reais, the bolsa said.
